QuestInfo.name: Angelic Buster?
QuestInfo.0: #p3000000# says he will tell you about the recent sensation in Pantheon, the Angelic Buster.
QuestInfo.1: Recently, a mysterious girl called the Angelic Buster started appearing to help people out. You're not sure how she does it...but doesn't that seem really similar to what you do?
QuestInfo.2: #p3000000# seems to think you should ally with Angelic Buster. You're not sure what to expect from a cross between a pop idol and a warrior, but you do need all the help you can get.

0.0: Oh, Kaiser. Have you heard about the #bAngelic Buster#k, by chance?\r\n#L0##bAn...gel... What?#l\n#k
0.1: What kind of a name is 'Angelic Buster,' anyway?

yes.0: She has a distinctive outfit, and seems to wield a mysterious magical power... She just appeared one day and started to help people out. She's already well-known in Pantheon. I think people are calling her an idol.
yes.1: I talked with her and she has a strong interest in protecting the Nova. Just like you, Kaiser.\r\n
yes.2: Her powers are still weak, but... I expect she will grow into a great warrior for the Nova, just like you. Meet with Angelic Buster when you have the chance. I think the two of you will become good allies.

no.0: Not interested? This will surely be helpful, even for you. Don't tell me you're spending too much time fighting to keep up with the news.

1.0: You two might have to compete on the heroing! Ha! Ha!
